env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_labels.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/const_for_labels.out
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cp main.lgo $WORK/original.lgo
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cmp main.lgo $WORK/original.lgo
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/labels .
exec $WORK/labels
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectlabels

go 1.27
